title: Sam and the Hat
skill_description: Read simple sentences independently with character, action, and outcome.
author: FunBookies
summary: Sam the cat wants a hat. A simple narrative with a character who takes action and achieves a goal.
targetPhonics: Simple narrative using all letters except b/d together, introducing simple story arc

A 9-panel reference sheet for children's book illustration style.

The 9 panels arranged in a 3x3 grid showing:

Consistent art style across all panels, suitable for children's picture book illustration. Each panel is a square vignette showing a key moment or character.

IMPORTANT: Minimize text in panels. Focus on visual style, characters, colors, and mood. No title text.

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover together. Point to pictures and ask: What do you see? This book helps practice reading skills.
parent_tips.during_reading: Point to each word as you read. Encourage your child to find pictures that match the words.
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask: What happened in the story? Can you find your favorite picture?
